## Historical audit — H0092

**Scope.** This is chunk 1 of 2 only. All event citations below refer to source **H0092**, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane2/codex_parallel_08_lane2_H_r1/infer_logs/ink-grid-box-layout/trajs.json`. No unseen chunk is inferred.

**Inferred goal:** add grid layout to Ink’s Box component. The original task instructions are not visible, so the precise required semantics are unknown.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Main agent events 3–8 | Creating the branch from `main` failed because that ref was absent; the agent inspected refs and created `grid-layout` from `master`. This was a recovered setup issue, not a terminal interruption. |
| Events 9–38 | The agent independently traced DOM, Yoga, styles, rendering and measurement. Before changes, a two-item `display: grid` reproduction returned an empty string (events 23–24); existing display mapping treated anything other than `flex` as hidden (event 30). |
| Events 39–52 | Successful edits added grid style and placement properties, mapped grid to Yoga flex display, created `grid-layout.ts`, and connected its layout routine to live and string rendering. The new routine parses tracks, places items and sets Yoga positions and dimensions (events 43–44). Thus the visible patch was not empty. |
| Events 53–56 | Initial typecheck passed. The reproduction then returned `A  B`, but the selected AVA run timed out. Later exploratory outputs showed wrapped text interleaving with the next row (events 61–62); after row remeasurement changes, the same examples produced separate wrapped rows (events 65–68). These examples are not comprehensive geometric verification. |
| Events 69–79 | Further changes addressed fractional and nested-grid sizing. A later typecheck/lint command timed out and was stopped (events 71–74). Event 79 requests reverting a sizing change, but its result is outside the visible chunk; execution cannot be assumed. |
| Top-level metadata [0,2148) | The recorded final response claims commit `ea5f7f2`, a passing typecheck and 42 selected tests, and one lint formatting fix without a lint rerun. These are reported outcomes, not independently visible command results in this chunk. Inventory marks evaluation missing. |

**Teacher input and adoption:** The inventory lists available hint archives and a captured-system-prompt path, but their contents are not supplied here. No delivered teacher text or adoption is visible in this chunk; availability does not establish receipt.

**Outcome:** Formal evaluation is **unknown**, not formal success or demonstrated algorithm failure. Visible evidence supports a nonempty implementation and limited successful examples, alongside timed-out validation. The top-level success status describes completion of the agent session, not benchmark correctness.

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Transferably, reproduce first, trace integration points, and distinguish a timed-out check from a pass. Task-specifically, wrapping required row remeasurement in the observed examples. Whether nested grids, dynamic updates, track bounds and other required cases work remains unresolved; the original requirements and remaining events are unavailable. This is a CLI layout task, not a Scene audit.
